hypotheses.justification: Split on N = 0; retain the existing proof for N ≠ 0. At zero, Nat.primeFactors_zero makes both products equal 1, so it suffices to show (Gamma0 0).index = 0. Write this index as I. For every prime p, Gamma0_le_Gamma0_of_dvd (by simp) gives Gamma0 0 ≤ Gamma0 p. Thus Subgroup.index_dvd_of_le and Gamma0_prime_index give p + 1 ∣ I. If I > 0, choose a prime p ≥ I using Nat.exists_infinite_primes; Nat.le_of_dvd then gives p + 1 ≤ I, a contradiction. Hence I = 0, and the zero-level equation holds too.
